request_content.question: Open question on the bound baseline-replay inventory (execution cf997605885642759ee33920e2c9e2ef, candidate baseline-replay, controller 8f837eb4…, 35 retained controller updates): terminal reach, sampled holding position, sampled holding speed and computation are reported together but disagree, and I want the relationship described rather than a cause asserted. (a) Terminal reach passes: reach_passed = true [f70952bb7daa1] with terminal tip error 0.007642608585867386 m [fff8ec664f4de] against the 0.01 m position limit [f12f1083f9849]; but joint_reach_holding_passed = false [f2bba4a48898d]. (b) Sampled holding position fails: holding_position_passed = false [f5ba2ab7e1107], and in the final holding window (6 selected samples, times 0.3–0.35 s [fa54c1ae23d4d, f5cdbebaa75dc]) tip error ranges 0.007642608585867386–0.05813810428573256 m [fb702504e6820, f321fd1d899fd], above the same 0.01 m limit. (c) Sampled holding speed fails: holding_speed_passed = false [fba496b7b7707], window tip speed ranges 0.6351726092425104–1.5810152739742807 m/s [f952823a6555c, ff296c4b0c654] against the 0.02 m/s speed limit [f4ab3008c7e24], with terminal tip speed 0.6351726092425104 m/s [ffad04d70b19c]; sampled_settling_passed = false [f641da2506e2e]. (d) Computation: 35 of 35 updates missed deadline [f4df9eb21672e] against a 0.01 s control period [fd007fcdf7be2], mean update 17.26331904856488 s [f071fab261a7e], and 35 updates [fd29a12daa2da] with stopping counts 34 User_Requested_Stop vs 1 Solve_Succeeded [f5c2fb5a6d4cc, f88b1091f6e15]; full_snapshots_available = false [ff7afc7fe179a]. Specific questions: (1) Is the terminal reach pass a property of one sampled endpoint only, distinct from the whole-trajectory holding behavior, given that the holding-window error maximum exceeds the reach tolerance? (2) Are holding-window position, holding-window speed and per-update computation best reported as co-occurring but separately scoped observations (terminal reach, holding position, holding speed, computation each independently), with sample coverage at most 6 rows and 35 updates? (3) Can the retained evidence support any statement linking the holding-window position/speed excursions to the computation record, or does it only support temporal co-occurrence? Report each answer as retrieved, not displayed, not retained, or not computable, and note that retained limitations state no historical optimizer iterations or full warm plans are reconstructed [f1f3274ca3bd7] and that a single execution does not establish a dominant cause [f15daf227e33d]; also note that a bounded projected-model probe (effective horizon <=0.01 s) is known to be insufficient to explain an entire settling failure and is not the basis of this question.
